name: 21 TSI
mood: luxury fashion editorial on black void
summary: A stark black-and-white fashion editorial system using Saans as the only typeface, white hairline navigation, transparent pill controls, full-bleed crimson photography, no shadows, no filled colored CTAs, and no max-width container.

layout.textPlacement: separate black space, not over photography

dos: Use black, white, and a single hairline for UI chrome.
Use Saans or a precise geometric sans everywhere.
Use positive tracking on uppercase UI labels.
Use 70px pill radius for all controls.
Use full-bleed images and large black negative space.
donts: Do not use red CSS fills, red buttons, or red borders.
Do not use filled colored CTAs.
Do not place body text over photography.
Do not add drop shadows, glows, glass, blur, or elevation.
Do not introduce a second typeface or icon font.
Do not use a max-width page container.
Do not use intermediate display sizes between 20px and 47px.
